question.text: In the sulphur estimation, <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>0</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>471</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi></math> of an organic compound gave <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>44</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi></math> of barium sulfate. The percentage of sulphur in the compound is. (Nearest integer) (Atomic Mass of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Ba</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>137</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">u</mi></math> )

solution.text:
233 g of BaSO4 contains 32 g sulphur.

Amount of S in 1.44 g of BaSO4=32233×1.44

So percentage of S in 0.471 of organic compound =32233×1.440.471×100=42%
